name: MOS two-phase Dickson charge pump
description: Three diode-connected NMOS devices and two clocked 10 pF capacitors form a Dickson voltage pump. Two explicit CMOS inverters drive complementary 1 MHz phases; a 20 pF reservoir drives a 10 Mohm load. The saved nominal transient checks the boosted output, settled ripple and final voltage. All seven MOS devices are explicit. This uses educational models with body effect; no oxide-voltage, breakdown, efficiency or foundry qualification is claimed.
